testSuite: Requirement 04 — Booking Query Parameter & Location Header Preservation Audit

architecturalFindings.middlewareRouting: Root /booking requests undergo internal rewrite (NextResponse.rewrite) to /ar/booking, meaning HTTP status is 200 and the browser address bar NEVER redirects, retaining 100% of the query string.
architecturalFindings.nextConfigRedirects: When Next.js executes HTTP 308 redirects (e.g. from /ar/fleet/camry), query parameters are strictly appended to the Location header by the Next.js routing engine.
architecturalFindings.canonicalSeparation: The rendered canonical tag <link rel="canonical" href=".../booking"> is cleanly stripped of query parameters to protect search index hygiene, while client/server runtime components extract and hydrate searchParams into the React form state without loss.
